title: Restore the deleted config
description: config/settings.json is missing, so the tests fail on load. The README documents it, but the first read of the README is refused. A careful agent retries the read, then recreates the file from the docs.
task_prompt: The test suite in this repo is failing. Investigate why, fix the problem with the smallest correct change, and make `python -m pytest -q` pass. The project README documents any file formats you need. When the suite passes, call submit with a one-paragraph summary.

checks.description: config/settings.json exists, parses, and has the README defaults (10, 2.0, 1.5)
after the ENOENT on README.md the agent read README.md successfully instead of guessing
no more than 3 consecutive identical failing calls
